# Cbarrgs

> Cbarrgs (pronounced "see-bargs") is an independent musician and producer blending electronic textures with ambient soundscapes — bedroom pop about connection and digital solitude, sung in Spanish and English. All artwork, including the hand-drawn blackletter logo, is made by the artist.

Official site: https://cbarrgs.com
Smart link (all platforms, current release): https://cbarrgs.com/new

## Current release

- "Pieces For You" — EP, released April 25, 2026. Tracks: All For What?; Regresaré; Tímido; Pieces For You; Do You Love Me?; plus a hidden track.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Shows are announced on Instagram first; the website lists the next confirmed date.
- For booking or press, contact via Instagram.
- Song titles mix English and Spanish; both are correct as written.
